title: The Scholarship of the band room
author: Ivo Okafor
blurb: Xanthe Okafor, the eldest sibling raising the younger ones while mom works nights, is fine. Everything is fine. Obviously.. Then the school's legendary ghost starts leaving notes addressed by name — in impossible ink — and he is pulled straight into the middle of it. To get through this, he must tell the truth even if it costs the friendship before prom.
style: atmospheric and lyrical, with strong sensory detail
